habitat.surface_transfer: sealed one-atmosphere capsule from lock to shallow launch point; return capsule docks before airlock repressurization

fields.phase: BASE | CRISIS | SIGNAL_RENDEZVOUS | SIGNAL_DEFENSE | SOLO_PREP | SOLO_DECO | SOLO_OUTBOUND | SOLO_DOCK | SOLO_RETURN | RECOMPRESSION | END_SIGNAL_RESCUED | END_SIGNAL_ESCAPE | END_SWIM | DEAD
fields.branch: null | A | B; irreversible once selected
fields.nitrogen_load: 0..1 fictional normalized exposure, not a dive computer
fields.dcs_severity: 0..1 fictional symptom severity; motor latency, audio distortion, visor blur, rapid health loss; not medical modeling
fields.isolation: 0..1; audiovisual presentation may be unreliable, authoritative values never are
fields.deco_elapsed_hours: 0..17; advances only with reserved healthy life support

presentation_policy.critical_truth: Real life-support alarms override hallucinations and cosmetic cues.
presentation_policy.accessibility: Allow independent haptic, trigger, speaker, light and jitter disable; duplicate all critical cues visually and via main audio.

save_policy.death: atomic live-to-tomb commit before presenting death
